title: 1997 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Fire Ox
seo_title: 1997 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Fire Ox (7 February – 27 January 1998)
description: 1997 is the Year of the Fire Ox (Yin, Ding-chou), from 7 February 1997 to 27 January 1998. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 1997.
lead: Born in 1997? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Ox, but check the date: the 1997 Fire Ox year began on 7 February 1997. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 1997: Year of the Fire Ox, from 7 February 1997 to 27 January 1998.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 1997 was the Year of the Ox. It began with Lunar New Year on 7 February 1997 and ended on 27 January 1998, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 1997 ends in 7, which makes it a Fire year, and as an odd year it is Yin. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 1997 is a Ding-chou year. The same Fire Ox combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1937 before it and 2057 after it.
Lunar New Year 1997 fell on 7 February 1997, so everyone born in January 1997, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Rat.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Ox guide describes the sign like this: “Reliable, honest, and hard-working. Oxen build success slowly and steadily through persistence.” The usual watch-out: “Can be stubborn and slow to adapt to sudden change.”

The Fire element adds its own flavour. Fire years bring passion, energy, and boldness. People of this element tend to be dynamic, adventurous, and quick to lead. Read more in our Fire element guide, or the full Year of the Ox page.
Careers often linked with the Ox: agriculture, engineering, finance, medicine.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 1997
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Ox's best matches are the Rat, Snake and Rooster, and its clash sign is the Goat, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Ox, it has no special traditional relationship with the Horse, so 2026 is a neutral year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Ox, it sits directly opposite the Goat, so 2027 is its clash year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Ox years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1973 (Water Ox); 1985 (Wood Ox); 2009 (Earth Ox); 2021 (Metal Ox). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 1997 is the Year of the Ox, a Yin Fire Ox year (Ding-chou).
When does the 1997 Year of the Ox start and end?
It starts on 7 February 1997 and ends on 27 January 1998.
I was born in January 1997. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Rat: Lunar New Year 1997 was on 7 February 1997, so all of January 1997 belongs to the Rat year.
Fire. 1997 ends in 7, which belongs to Fire, and it is a Yin year.
Who is the Ox compatible with?
Traditionally the Rat, Snake and Rooster. The Ox's clash sign is the Goat.
